notes.title: [Update Notice] Balance + reward patch
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the ANVIL dev team. 

Thank you everyone for the numerous feedback. We especially appreciate your understanding regarding balancing issue as due to few unforeseen problems, the game came out more difficult than intended. Currently there are two major issues regarding difficulty balancing.

Players are unable to complete the build they want.
[list]
[*] According to our original dev schedule, the relic chests being unique to each user should have been applied for Early Access version. However, that did not happen due to development problems, making it difficult for players to create their builds. Having the right relic set and failing to do so is a huge difference. As a result, players felt they were less strong than they should be, leading to the rise in difficulty. To resolve this issue, we made a quicker response to apply relics not being shared between team members and increased the effects of 5-stack based relics.
[/list]

2.	Single player mode being overwhelmingly difficult. 
[list]
[*] ANVIL is originally designed as a multiplayer game. As the standard difficulty and experience started out for multiplayer, the single player mode that was added later in development can feel difficult. The dev team considered the single player mode not as a training mode, but as a challenge mode. However, with the game currently not having a separate game mode to practice, there were a lot more people starting out with single player than expected.
[*] In the long run, we are thinking of adding beginner mode or practice mode. As this takes time, we appreciate your understanding that this isn’t applied immediately.
[/list]

The main idea of this update is for players to become stronger instead of the enemies to become weaker. To be more specific, it is for players to create builds that they want and be able to feel it. As for the alert level monsters, instead of making them weaker, we decided to give more reward when players overcome this challenge and we enhanced the amount of VP and probability of relic replication depending on how far your run is in the galaxy.

Our priority for this update will be addressing player feedback that can be applied immediately. Addition of new relics that enhance shooter type Breakers and improvements to skill power increase as well as other features will be applied in the next update.

In addition, sudden deaths, season resets and other things are being discussed internally, and we are constantly putting an effort to improve our game in the right direction.

Many of you have left feedback and we think whether they were positive or negative, they are all advice that can help us make a better game. Thank you for your interest and we will constantly strive to make ANVIL better.


[h1]#Improvements to difficulty[/h1]

[h3]Czerny final boss difficulty lowered [/h3]
The final boss will be around 20% less strong (attack, defense, health) than current level

[h3]All 5-stack relics gain increased effects[/h3]
We increased the basic effect of stack relic and the special effect given from 3rd stack onward by 1.5 times the current amount.

[h3]Removing relic share system[/h3]
The relic chests will not be shared among team members in multiplayer mode.
This will lead to players being able to create the build they want more easily.
This should have been applied for Early Access, and we apologize that this was applied later than we wanted.

[h3]Improvements to alert level waves[/h3]
The alert level system that threatened the players after a period of time has been improved.
In Symphonia, the alert level duration has been shortened to 45 sec from 60 sec.
The reward for overcoming the alert level has been increased in all the galaxies.
-	High chance of heal pack drop
-	Increase to tier of weapon dropped
-	Increase to amount of coin dropped 

[h3]Removal of mechanical monsters in time limit survival mission[/h3]
We changed the mechanical monsters to other monsters in time-based mission maps because they were too strong. Players will be able to proceed more smoothly.

[h1]#Improvements to reward system[/h1]

[h3]Season Pass now easier to achieve[/h3]
We increased the amount of experience player receive per planet clear in a galaxy by 25~50%.
As a result, players should be able to each the next level of Season Pass easier than before.
As for the rewards in the Season Pass, they will be revamped to feel more rewarding in the next Pass.

[h3]Relic replication rule improvement[/h3]
In the current algorithm, the chance of relic replication when you acquire a relic already in possession is lower than intended. 
We changed so that a relic besides the ones you own will be replicated.
Players will be able to feel 20~30% increase in relic replication chance.

[h1]#Bug fixes[/h1]

Resolve a case where a player is unable to enter a lair of a specific boss monster

Resolve a case where effects on certain weapons are not applied
-	Heal upon hit
-	Increasing number of evasive skills
-	Gaining coin at start of each planet

Fixed where the melee and ranged damage decrease on the stat page had an English translation error.

[list]
[*] The urgent update will be applied to only the Steam version. As the Xbox version needs a separate certification process, we will apply it at a later date. During this period of time, cross platform between Xbox and Steam will be restricted. We will do our best to apply the update on Xbox ASAP. 

[*] In order to apply the new update, exit ANVIL and relaunch after the update.
[/list]

Thank you.

notes.title: [Dev Blog] Sharing relics in multiplayer mode
notes.notes:
[Dev Blog] Sharing relics in multiplayer mode

Hello, this is Wonho Son.

Anvil’s Early Access / Game Preview date has been confirmed for Dec. 2 and is approaching fast. While this news is super exciting, there is a lot to prepare, so I am both worried and excited. Today, I will be discussing the relic sharing system that many people have given feedback about.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/ded078020a38a71013b84030d1aab7187a365701.jpg[/img]

The idea of sharing relics in multiplayer started with the intention of giving a way for players to communicate with each other.
If there isn’t anything information to convey in multiplayer mode, there would be few reasons for communication. By sharing relics, I hoped people would communicate in different ways.

In the first playtest, both the positive and negative sides of sharing relics were found.
The positive aspect was that in teams that had good communication, the relic sharing system acted as a means of collaboration. Players shared relics, discussed who would be best to take a certain relic, and were considerate of other players’ situations.
In other teams, however, the same features were the source of the problems. Without any communication, one player would rush to the vaults and buy all the good relics while the other user stacked up gold without the means to use them, making the game less enjoyable.

The development team contemplated on the two opposite results. We had three demo tests after the first, and to cut to the results, we felt that our intentions were good, but our method of bringing it to the game had problems. Sharing relics became an obstacle to players creating their personal builds, which led people to play in restricted freedom and made the gameplay boring instead of making the game more fun. Instead of making multiplayer mode feel like a collaboration, players felt that they were obstructed by teammates.

After much discussion, we decided to make the relics in the vaults exclusive to each player. One thing that’s a shame is that too much time passed before making this decision, which has led to the relics being shared between players for the Early Access version.

Making relics exclusive to each player isn’t just about disabling the share feature but came with considerations for technical modifications as well as the balance between characters. This was more than what the development team expected so instead of risking releasing the game in an unstable state which can lead to bugs, we thought it’d be wiser to thoroughly test the feature and update the game later.

After Early Access, many aspects of Anvil will continue to change.
If you have any good ideas, please share!
The development team is always taking note of all your feedback.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Dev Blog] Delving into status effects
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Wonho Son.
Today, I’ll be discussing the status effects of the AnVIL battle system.
I will go over the different status effects implemented in the game and give you in-game tips.

[h1]Types of Status Effects[/h1]

There are currently four different types of status effects: burn, freeze, petrification, and shock. There were more in the early stages of development, but we decided to reduce it down to four and try to synergize between them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/ab4d2e2de8ce31f61d73f79769c6ff73096f1404.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Cause N% of your attack damage every second for 15 seconds
[*] Does not stack
[*] More effective the higher your attack damage is
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/cede12bd18da6a0edb88f5319c7203263d0c9e15.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Freezes target for 5 seconds, making them unable to perform an action
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/4ba33fae40be689f480bd2eca9db59cf28c6953f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Petrifies enemies for 7 seconds, making them unable to perform an action
[*] Petrified enemy’s defense sharply increases
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/03c8001e7661820bd88058e1ce6b25464bfa6e19.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Shocks enemies for 15 seconds, greatly reducing their defense
[*] Useful in multiplayer mode boss battles
[/list]

Besides these four, although there are fewer implementations, poison exists as well. Weapons such as venomcaster and relics like poison greaves will allow you to poison enemies. In the future, we will introduce a breaker that has poison as their main kit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/b2b145fc2a5398dc801dc57e1e76983d30a74484.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Cause N% of your attack damage every second for 15 seconds
[*] Can stack up to N times
[*] The higher the enemy’s health, the more efficient
[/list]

[h1]Status Effect Immunity[/h1]

[b]Basic immunity[/b]
[list]
[*] A target that has been under status effect will receive 20% reduced effect time in the following status effects
[*] For example, a target frozen once for 5 seconds will only be able to be frozen for 4 seconds
[*] As such, forming different a co-op team with breakers that have different status effects is efficient
[/list]


[b]Planet immunity[/b]
[list]
[*] Monsters in jungle theme planets are immune to poison
[*] Monsters in dessert theme planets are immune to petrification
[*] Monsters in tundra theme planets are immune to freeze
[*] Monsters in volcanic theme planets are immune to burn
[*] Machine themed monsters are immune to shock
[/list]


[b]Enemy tier immunity[/b]
[list]
[*] Different tier enemies have different immunity times
[*] Boss / raid boss monsters take 50% reduced status effects
[/list]


[b]Boss battle immunity[/b]
[list]
[*] AnVIL bosses have battle phases
[*] Each health bar is a different phase
[*] When phases change, all status effect on the boss monster is removed and they become immune to all status effects for a short period
[*] It is wise to stop attacking and step back to see what pattern the boss will attack with
[/list]

[h1]Tips for good status effect use[/h1]

[list]
[*] Shock is good for fighting boss monsters, so it is good to have a breaker with shock ability in the team.
[*] Having two or more breakers with the same status effect is inefficient
[*] It is better not to apply an additional status effect (freeze, petrification, etc.) that makes the boss unable to perform an action when it is already unable to perform an action
[*] It is better to apply the status effect after the previous one is over
[/list]

We went into detail for the blog today, but for players to enjoy AnVIL to its fullest, especially to create good breaker combinations in multiplayer mode, an understanding of how the status effects work is crucial.
Any cool ideas on how to improve the status effect system or personal opinions on the system are always welcome.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Dev Blog] Should we show DPS of teammates in multiplayer
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Wonho Son,

Today, I’ll be discussing a matter that I have been contemplating on.
“Showing DPS of teammates in multiplayer mode”

Right now, in AnVIL, the DPS meter is in place for each planet so players can check their current strength. The DPS meter resets upon entering the planets, effectively showing how much damage per second the player is dealing in the given planet. With this system, players can check their offensive stats and how well they are powering up.
(The development team uses this to find damage related bugs ^^)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/269ef67aa67f059ef7a54cdbd3bacd0ab215fde5.png[/img]

Some players want the DPS system to expand. That is, they want to check the DPS of their teammates. There are many reasons for this such as wanting to compete with others and wanting to show off their own damage.

However, some people prefer to keep their DPS hidden. They want to enjoy team play and are uncomfortable sharing their DPS, which only shows the offensive power of a Breaker.

There are other opinions. Some say it’s a good idea to show progress to teammates, but only showing DPS can be misleading. Therefore, players should be able to see damage taken, the number of times revived and other statistical information… (We apologize. These aren’t options we can develop now and will have to wait until after Early Access to be implemented.)

What do you guys think?
Should we share individual DPS values between teammates?
Or should it remain as is, only showing your DPS to you alone?
Or are there other ideas?
Let us know!

Thank you.

notes.title: [Dev Blog] New Breaker Introduction - Bronte
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Wonho Son.
Today, I’ll be giving an in-depth introduction on Bronte, the newest breaker added to our game.

[b]God of thunder and lightning, Brontes[/b]

The name Bronte originates from Brontes, the Cyclops in Greek mythology who is the God of thunder.
In the early stages, the concept for the new breaker revolved around her ability to shock enemies using lightning-based attacks, so we decided to find a name that was related to thunder.
Her initial name was Electra but after contemplation, we decided on Bronte.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/08fcb27c0eac6c356044b765c47997b4155ef9f8.png[/img]
Early raw Bronte artwork: Helmet parts

[b]Indra, a handgun that fires lightning[/b]
Bronte’s basic weapon, “Indra,” fires piercing lightning in a straight line.
It is a powerful weapon that shocks enemies and greatly reduces their defense with just basic auto attacks.
It's effective as a supporting handgun in multiplayer mode as decreasing the boss monster’s defense is crucial.

[b]Electrician that pulls in enemies and blows them up at once[/b]

Bronte is a long-range supporter specializing in destroying multiple enemies at once.
Use [b][Eye of the Plasma][/b] to pull in enemies, and when enough enemies are sucked in, use [b][Detonate][/b] to kill them in one skill. [b][Bionic Pulse][/b] can save your team against powerful bosses that poison or cause burn.


[b][Eye of the Plasma][/b]

Fires a plasma orb. The orb pulls in enemies caught in its path and shocks them.


[b][Detonate][/b]

Causes the plasma orb to explode. On use, shocks nearby enemies while damaging and stunning enemies caught inside the explosion.


[b][Bionic Pulse][/b]

Emits a special electric pulse. Status effects are removed from allies within range and grants them movement speed bonus.


[b][Teleport][/b]
Teleports to target location. On use, leaves a decoy that shocks nearby enemies and grants shield.


[previewyoutube=2F8K7c4Nb40;full][/previewyoutube]


Bronte takes some skill to get used to but gives a different type of gameplay to enjoy.
Whenever you have a good idea regarding Bronte, let us know!
The development team is always open to player opinions and comments.

Thank you.

notes.title: [DEV BLOG] About Seasons
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Wonho Son. 

Today we wanted to provide more information on the newly introduced Season Pass and how the ‘seasons’ will be carried out. This feature is implemented in the current demo version. We were originally going to announce more information about this feature in the future, but it seems like there were quite a few players who were curious to know how the feature will be implemented into the game, so we thought we include this information on this week’s posting. 

[b]What is Season? [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/428c48b56613d71dff3a0677a0a575d6880736a9.jpg[/img]

Roguelike games tend to be fun, but there is a limited amount of content available in the game. In general, the Seasons are supposed to provide and encourage new goals and objectives to players. We will be making constant feature updates and balance patches to the game itself, but Season Update is meant to renew the game’s metadata, add/remove contents and apply changes based on player feedback to optimize the overall gameplay experience. 

The Galaxy, which is the group of ‘Planets’ that you explore, will be updated every 3 months with new bosses and new types of combat missions (escort mission, delivery mission, defense mission, etc.), along with the introduction of a new Toy Worker and Breakers. 

We will not be simply adding new content to the game, but rather applying big changes to existing content. Such changes will be based on player feedback. 

There will be large-scale updates to change balances between the Breakers as well as new skill upgrades, and new types of weapons and relics, thus providing continued changes. 

[b]Season Pass and Season Upgrade[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/fd206b1b7aac8af615f590f3937fec1ab2964763.jpg[/img]

Season Pass is not very difficult. You can earn Kron from progressing in Season Pass which you can use to unlock Toy Workers or purchase skins. Kron is not something you have to buy with real money. You can earn Krons by collecting VPs and progressing in Season Pass. Of course, it might be difficult to unlock all the skins in a day, but in time getting all the skins shouldn’t be too difficult. 

Season Pass was originally provided to offer long-term goals within the game. You can earn new skins before others by purchasing/progressing on a Premium Pass, but all new skins can also be purchased with Krons in the following season, so it’s just a matter of time before you collect all the skins. 

You can use your Season Points that you’ve earned from your progression Season Pass in Season Upgrades - this is the growth system within the season. Only the basic stat enhancements will be provided during pre-season (Early Access?), but once the Season system is actually “live” (we’re thinking version 1.0) the stat enhancement will be more than just a simple stat boost but will include more exciting abilities that are ideal or that coincide with current season meta. 

If we were to keep all player’s progression, ANVIL will no longer be considered a roguelike game. There will be a big gap between new players and existing players, and character progression/growth will be a more dominant factor than the player’s skill. This is why we’d like to offer a new Season Upgrade every season. We’d like to provide more fun and transformation, and in order to do this, we need to reset the progress every season. 

Season Points can be earned by everyone fairly. We do not want players to “grind” in order to collect Season Points. When a new season begins, we’d like to see players earn Upgrade Points easily/quickly to collect and build a character according to your liking. This is the purpose behind Season Upgrade. 

[b]Season Relics[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/7dfcadc8ff30e729bc92c3a3a0d769623c9412e3.jpg[/img]

Relics are the most dynamic part of the Season system. There will be diverse types of new Relics added to the game every season - and at the same time, unpopular Relics will be removed/edited. Keeping unpopular Relics in the game will just clutter the game with unused Relics. 

This is why we are planning to reset the Relics stat after every season. All the Relics will be deleted? Yes, some may worry about this. But remember that Relics are not released based on chances. If you get Relic X after a run, then next time around you’re going to get a different Relic. No matter how rare a Relic is, you’re bound to get them after a fair amount of play. 

When you start a new season, you will earn new Relics with new effects. You will be able to equip your Relics according to the new season’s meta. 

[b]Things that remain after a season[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/b6fca2647d88808ffe39da384aef43fba301be40.jpg[/img]

Breakers, Toy Workers, skins, and Krons will remain with you even after a season and will not be removed or deleted. Relics and what not has the ‘need’ to be reset, but other things that you collect throughout the season will remain with you. 

We only mean to keep the ‘season’ element in order to offer fresh new experiences and tactics at the beginning of each season. We want players to be able to find a match in multiplayer mode. Co-op is a core gameplay experience that we want every user to enjoy in ANVIL. We want to encourage existing players to play with new players without much gap, and this is why we’re including a reasonable amount of factors that update and add new elements. 

We do not think there’s a perfect solution to approach the season element. We are also debating internally whether to make some selected Relics permanent and also giving out rewards according to the number of Relics collected. 

We’re open to ideas, so please don’t hesitate to share them with us in implementing the Season system! 

We’d be happy to consider different methods in implementing seasons in the game. 

Thank you



Everything mentioned here today, are of course subject to change in the future. 😊

notes.title: [DEV BLOG]
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/2ae3813de58909c38fa48a3c449463e51e1e246a.jpg[/img]

Hello, my name is Wonho, head of development for ANVIL. 
I wanted to start writing a weekly blog post to keep you all informed about our motivation for making this game as well as going over the game system. We’ll do a weekly posting every Tuesday, Korean time. Yes, we’re based in Korea. 

I wanted to start off by explaining where the name “ANVIL” came from. Although our game description says it’s an acronym for “Ancient Vault Investigation Lab,” that’s not entirely true. The more important meaning of ANVIL is in the ‘anvil’ word itself.

ANVIL is our first Steam title. Some of the team members had worked on different Steam projects before, but most of our team come from developing PC online games and mobile games. 
Starting something new is always exciting. We had embarked on our new project with high hopes and expectations. The most exciting? Communicating with you guys, the players.

Here comes ANVIL. A strong anvil made from iron and steel. 
Our development team is the anvil, and our game is the red-hot iron that’s being molded into something wonderful. Who is the hammer? It’s you, the players. 

This is where the name comes from. ANVIL. 

If you had a chance to try out our demo back in June, you might have noticed that the game itself is still rough around the edges. The game still requires more fixing, more optimizing… more ‘pounding’ and more ‘forging’. 

There are many unique Breakers and weapons you can choose from, as well as planets that are randomly generated and are filled with various boss monsters. 

For now, that’s all we have. The development team is working day and night to add various game systems to make the game more fun, but we know that it’s not enough. 

We will be a steadfast anvil.
Hammer on it to make the game a great sword.
Hammer relentlessly!

If you have any cool ideas for us, please share them with us on Discord or reply to this post below! 
You don’t think we’re replying enough?

Don’t worry. I don’t speak English well, but I’m reading all your messages. Your valuable suggestions are being recorded in my notebook and will eventually be implemented in the game, someday. 

I’ll be back next week with more insights into our game. 

Thank you for reading.

notes.title: [System Introduction] ANVIL Database
notes.notes:
You can access the ANVIL database through the database terminal on the left side of the ANVIL. 
To access the ANVIL database, you must connect to the database terminal on the left side of the ANVIL.
The database contains records obtained while fighting enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/3b673d47b0cd220bd855df96f68c5c157169860e.png[/img]

The terminal is labeled “Database” on the floor so you can easily find it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/5aa8c3736d0eeeb55bc463b9c75fa9354cf11d9f.png[/img]

In the current ANVIL DB, you can check data on relics, weapons, and Breaker skill enhancement devices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/56c42a517ab66a69ab94f7d8c261bf290f8ab22b.png[/img]

In the relic DB, you can check the shapes and abilities of relics that can be acquired in-game.
Remember the last time I introduced you to the "Relic Cloning System"?
If the relic is successfully duplicated, it is activated in the database, and detailed information about the relic will be displayed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/c1540760332155eae392c14241b054f8c07bff3d.png[/img]

In the weapon DB, you can see the data of all the weapons dropped in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/2f1c2cbc2593cf002ff57c85b6e8ab72d48e1484.png[/img]

Shooter-type Breakers can use rifles, shotguns,
Fighter-type Breakers can use axes, hammers, and gauntlets.
Technician-type Breakers can use handguns and cannons.
Each weapon has its own characteristics, so if you are aware of the characteristics of the weapon in advance, you can quickly make your selection by judging the characteristics of weapons dropped in battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/fd54a4d98ef79d7a83f3f44c556585e1ae127d9f.png[/img]
 
Werewolf Gauntlets is a great weapon for tank Breakers because they regenerate their health every time they attack the enemy.
Lastly, in the skill enhancement DB, you can check the skill enhancement device of each Breaker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/814f11706bbe308920addfe15286aacca360045e.png[/img]

Breaker's playstyle may change depending on the skill enhancement, so it will be much more helpful to check the data in advance in the ANVIL DB before departing on your explorations.
ANVIL DB has just been developed as a prototype. There are still many features to be added and need to be optimized. If you have any good ideas, please tell us!

notes.title: [Boss Monster] Uranos Arma
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/493214be258dc739d05d18477e0e57454f436249.png[/img]
 
Hi everyone! Today we’re going to introduce you to one of the boss monsters that appear in the game called “Uranos Arma”.


[h2][b]Uranos Arma[/b]
[/h2]Uranos Arma was the 5th creation that the mechanical god Uranos had created. Uranos Arma was created in a shape that resembles  ‘armadillo’ from earth. It can roll up its body to block attacks and use its razor-sharp shells to attack the enemies. Its attack pattern is relatively simple but damage from its attacks can be devastating. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/4ef47a3d973e761af1d77c0eddb78c027ee461d2.gif[/img]

“Toast”, our new Vault Breaker under development, using a mid-range flamethrower to hunt the boss monster. 


[h2][b]Rolling Attack[/b] 
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/152469fc95424f6b7252cae96361ae78c1ac15c5.gif[/img]

This is Uranos Arma’s basic attack. It rolls forward and whips you with its tail. You should be able to avoid getting hit by dodging sideways. 


[h2][b]Spinning Attack[/b]
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/b5a678ddff7a349f6b20cab869671a3c82d42c0e.gif[/img]
 
Rolls sideways and whips its tail in a large area. Because this attack has a long reach, you must keep a considerable distance from the monster. Dues to this, it makes it harder for close-ranged Breakers to get close and attack them. 


[h2][b]Shell Attack[/b]
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/27c29de920995e093177245b5ed23f458ce0cf64.gif[/img]

It spins its body in a circular motion and attacks anyone that is nearby with its razor-sharp shell. At first, it may seem like it’s attacking randomly, but if you look closely, there’s a pattern to its attack. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/fa8c1610d229d0fea400c99d6cf31645a5ecc2f1.gif[/img]
Note that Toast has a shield that can be used to block such attacks making him a good fit to take on Uranos Arma! 


[h2][b]Charging Attack[/b]
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/460254c4be800cbe70c549e3124b24814dde6fec.gif[/img]
 
This is an attack skill where Uranos Arma spins rapidly, then charges straight ahead. It’s very fast so you must predict which way it’s going to attack to dodge successfully. After attacking, it’s left vulnerable for a brief moment so it’s important to inflict as much damage as possible during that time.

notes.title: [Plot] Age of war and heroes
notes.notes:
The war… 
It was a devastating war. 

Many planets were destroyed, and humanity suffered great losses from the mechas that called themselves god. 
The chances for humanity’s survival seemed hopeless. 
But as usual, they did not give up. No, they would not give up. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/19ea5daf508f86c05719a96c1ead798604f84883.jpg[/img]

Many heroes suited up in their battle suits, or Breakers, and fought against the oncoming enemies. 
Mountain blocked countless machines by itself earning the nickname ‘the wall’. 
Jungler utilized guerilla tactics to distract enemies in the jungle. 
Uzi had penetrated deep behind enemy lines and took out the mecha general. 
You were able to survive due to the sacrifices of countless heroes and their actions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/f56291f57e9138d7062627aedb77b0a4ae0a4a34.jpg[/img]

By utilizing the “AMBER” which allows you to resurrect over and over in different Breaker bodies and utilizing the alien technologies that you’ve discovered from the alien relics, you have learned how to harness and utilize alien powers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/7c6172ab8537a9b7a22dd7d4254a7c4732e5819b.jpg[/img]

You do not have to worry about death. 
Because we have “Breakers” that utilize data that had been recovered from the heroes that protected humanity. 
Even if the Breaker is destroyed, as long as the “AMBER” is OK, we will be able to bring you back to life through ANVIL. 
Even if your Breaker is destroyed more than a hundred times, you can still come back in a new Breaker suit and fight, stronger than ever! 
You are not alone. 
Thousands of ANVILs are back in operation again. 

Now, let’s start the counterattack!

notes.title: Dev Blog - Relic Slots and Collection Book
notes.notes:
[b]Introduction
[/b]
ANVIL is a game where you take control of a Vault Breaker to explore the galaxies filled with danger. Your mission is to find Vaults that contain powerful Relics. 
Each galaxy has unique Relics hidden within. 
In order to get the Relics that you want, you’ll need to explore all the galaxies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/af70434dfae2a2af4ba5b18ccf981d9d75aab974.png[/img]

[b]Relic Reproduction 
[/b]The Relics that you have acquired through the exploration will disappear when your Breaker is destroyed. But if you’re lucky, you’ll be able to duplicate the data of a Relic that you had and send it to ANVIL. 
As your exploration takes you deeper into the galaxies, your chance of reproducing a Relic increases. 
If you have completed your exploration of the galaxy, you will have a 100% chance to duplicate successfully. 

[b]Relic Slots
[/b]Each Breaker comes with slots where you can equip the Relics and harness its powers. 
More slots are opened if you meet certain requirements, allowing you to equip up to 4 relics. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/8e3aec9167d35f4593c5e268c754e7c1fb0f3969.png[/img]

[b]Customizing
[/b]Relics can be set differently for each Breakers. 
You can improve your survivability by equipping Relics that improve your defense and boost your HP, or you can choose to improve your attack capabilities by equipping Relics that enables faster attacks and randomly triggers certain additional damage upon a successful hit. 
As you get familiar with all the Relics and the Breakers, you’ll be able to find which combination works best for you!

[b]Relics DB
[/b]Relics that have been successfully duplicated can be viewed in the Collection Book. From this book, you can also see which ones you have yet to collect and information on where you can find them.

notes.title: First Post - Plot
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/d50cd6d899602b00e6629ac52bf7adfe18ad675b.jpg[/img]
It all started with the Vault.

With the advent of the intergalactic space ages humanity had rapidly expanded its presence across the universe but were suddenly halted by an unknown force. 

The human race did not have a chance against these unknown enemies that had far superior technology. 

At the brink of total annihilation, the human race discovered a Vault at the edge of the universe.
By analyzing the technical code found within the Vault they discovered a key technology that would help them fight against the enemies and turn the tide around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/59340c4d19e48d77fc93800826832e16b24a5f63.jpg[/img]

AnVIL(Ancient Vault Investigation Lab) was created based on the technology found in “Origin”, the first Vault ever found. 

The Vaults that had been discovered so far contained various types of power, energy, and technology. By harnessing them, the human race was able to create immortal warriors called the Vault Breakers that can be destroyed and rebuilt repeatedly. 

The Anvils were mass-produced to locate other Vaults that are scattered throughout the universe. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/749d5325ecb0b69697503bdc3ef65a4d6fc713db.jpg[/img]

Your Breakers are to be deployed to the edge of the universe to galaxies that are crawling with alien monsters. 
The mechanical forces will try to stop you. The alien monsters will attack fiercely. 
During exploration, your Vault Breakers will be destroyed dozens, or even hundreds, of times. 

But do not be worried. The destroyed Breakers will be reassembled in AnVIL. 
The newly reassembled Breaker will be stronger than before. 
Repeated destruction and reassembly will only make them more powerful! 

Now, take a deep breath… and get ready for an action-packed shooting adventure!
